answer_1.quote: Building on these insights, we introduce CHAIN-OF-TALKERS (COTALK), an novel AI-in-theloop annotation framework...

answer_2.quote: To overcome this, we introduce an alternative evaluation based on semantic units-object-attribute pairs extracted by LLMs from detailed captions to construct semantic trees.

answer_3.quote: We employ a text-based LLM to decompose image captions into their semantic units and assess them according to the number of semantic units identified.
methods: decomposition of captions into object-attribute pairs

answer_4.quote: Eight annotators answer five questions per image in both text and audio formats.
answer_4.guideline: Participants answer questions based on annotations presented in text or audio format to compare comprehension speed and accuracy.
